data.name: DataFlowPriorityUnranked
data.comment: Priority column, for a contribution that has never been given a position (the sentinel, not a number).

data.name: DataFlowPriorityOfContributors
data.comment: Priority column: this contribution's position, then the number of contributors sharing its Metaverse Attribute.

data.name: DataFlowPriorityTooltipOutbound
data.value: Priority orders competing contributions into the Metaverse, so it applies to Inbound flows only.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Priority cell of an Outbound flow.

data.name: DataFlowPriorityTooltipSoleContributorUnranked
data.value: This is the only contributor to this Metaverse Attribute, so it is not competing with anything and has never needed a position.
data.comment: Tooltip: the only contribution to a Metaverse Attribute, never given a position.

data.name: DataFlowPriorityTooltipSoleContributorRanked
data.value: This is the only contributor to this Metaverse Attribute, so its position decides nothing until another Synchronisation Rule contributes to it.
data.comment: Tooltip: the only contribution to a Metaverse Attribute, already given a position.

data.name: DataFlowPriorityTooltipUnpositionedOfMany
data.value: This contribution has never been given a position, so it ranks lowest of the {0} contributors to this Metaverse Attribute. Give it a position to change that.
data.comment: Tooltip: an unpositioned contribution among several. {0} is the number of contributors.

data.name: DataFlowPriorityTooltipOrdered
data.value: {0} Synchronisation Rules contribute to this Metaverse Attribute; the lowest-numbered contribution with a value wins.
data.comment: Tooltip on a Priority cell among several contributors. {0} is always two or more.

data.name: DataFlowDirectionInbound
data.comment: Direction of a Synchronisation Rule flow: into the Metaverse.

data.name: DataFlowDirectionOutbound
data.comment: Direction of a Synchronisation Rule flow: out of the Metaverse.

data.name: ResolutionTenMicroseconds
data.comment: A DateTime resolution, as the attribute editor names it.

data.name: WatermarkNextDeltaImportReadsAfter
data.value: Next Delta Import reads changes after
data.comment: Partition scope line: the position a Delta Import reads from. The position follows this text.

data.name: WatermarkRecordedAt
data.comment: Partition scope line: when the watermark was recorded. {0} is a relative time such as '3 hours ago'.

data.name: WatermarkUnreadable
data.value: The recorded watermark could not be read. The next Delta Import reads every object in this partition, as a Full Import does, and records a new one.
data.comment: Partition scope line when the recorded watermark cannot be read.

data.name: WatermarkNone
data.value: No watermark recorded. The next Delta Import reads every object in this partition, as a Full Import does, and records one.
data.comment: Partition scope line when no watermark has been recorded yet.
